name: The Wood Factory
old_description: Since our beginning at The Wood Factory, we’ve dedicated ourselves to producing historically accurate millwork at an affordable price. Our elegant Victorian gingerbread treatments brings to homes historical accuracy and a sense of individual character. Almost all our Victorian designs have been painstakingly researched and copied from turn-of-the-century catalogues, photographs and architectural drawings. However, we’ve also custom matched designs working from customers’ sketches and photographs, from architects’ renderings and from original samples sent to us.
about:
The Wood Factory operates from Winterport, Maine, where it produces historically accurate millwork with a focus on Victorian-era gingerbread treatments. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, but its mission has centered on making period-appropriate architectural details accessible at an affordable price point.

The shop specializes in reproducing Victorian designs that have been researched from turn-of-the-century catalogues, photographs, and architectural drawings. In addition to its catalog of standard patterns, the company offers custom matching services, working from customer sketches, photographs, architects' renderings, or original samples sent to the facility. Specific production processes, facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not published.

The Wood Factory serves homeowners, architects, and contractors involved in historical restoration and new construction that calls for authentic period millwork. Its customer base includes individuals seeking to restore or replicate Victorian gingerbread details, as well as design professionals who provide renderings or original samples for replication.

The company distinguishes itself through its research-driven approach to historical accuracy, drawing on primary sources from the Victorian era, and by offering custom replication services that accommodate a range of input formats, from hand-drawn sketches to physical samples.
